summary: MarineMax filed an 8-K reporting the refinancing of its existing credit agreement with a new $950 million floor plan facility, a $150 million revolver, a $302.5 million term loan, and an $85 million mortgage loan facility, all maturing June 2031. The filing is a routine refinancing of existing credit facilities—not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or capital return. The new credit agreement adjusts interest rate spreads but does not involve a change of control, activist campaign, or shareholder event. No deal terms (price, premium, close date) are applicable. This is a standard current report on a material definitive agreement and creation of a direct financial obligation.
